items.quote: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
items.claim: Noah opened the window of the ark at the end of forty days

items.quote: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
items.claim: Noah sent forth a raven which went forth to and fro until the waters were dried up from the earth
